literal_meaning: একদিন না একদিন (one day or another day)
figurative_meaning_en: Certainly one day; sooner or later
example_sentences_in_bangla: তোমার এই ভুলের ফল একদিন-না-একদিন তোমাকে কষ্ট দেবে।
example_sentences_in_english: The consequences of your mistake will catch up with you sooner or later.
The truth will come out one day or another.
note: Often used to imply that actions, especially wrong ones, will have inevitable outcomes, reflecting a sense of moral causality in Bengali proverbs.
